import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { employee } from "../../../backend/schema/employee";

export const employeeCms = customizeTable<typeof employee>("employee", {
    display: {
        title: "lastName"
    },
    listFields: ["employeeId", "title", "firstName", "lastName", "email", "phone"],
    fieldOrder: [
        "employeeId",
        "title",
        "firstName",
        "lastName",
        "email",
        "phone",
        "state",
        "birthDate",
        "hireDate",
        "address",
        "city",
        "country",
        "postalCode",
        "fax",
        "reportsToRelation"
    ]
});
